descriptions_zh.preferred: 紫色网纹是这一令人惊艳的引种品种的显著特征，它属于来自俄勒冈的 Ghost 系列之一。 其春叶极为出色，叶色为深红色，并带有更深的红紫色网状叶脉。 夏季叶色保持为红色，叶脉及叶缘呈深紫红色。 秋季叶片转为火焰橙色和猩红色。 大型 7 裂叶深裂，叶缘具明显尖锐锯齿，并带有富观赏性的微皱边缘。 该树半直立、圆整，预计可长至约 10–12 英尺（3–3. 9 m）高、5 英尺（1. 5 m）宽，是园林景观中极具戏剧性对比效果或焦点价值的品种。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Purple Ghost' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Purple Ghost' Purple Reticulated Variegated Japanese Maple Ghost Series Zones 5-9 ‘Purple Ghost’ is a very striking tree that adds a blast of color. This leaf has deep lavender and purple colors divided by a dark maroon reticulated vein. Acer palmatum 'Purple Ghost' is heavily sought after for its dynamic color. The growth habit is upright with dense branching in semi-pendulous habit. ‘Purple Ghost’ grows to 8-10 ft tall and wide in 15 years. Filtered evening sun is suggested to bring out the best colors. 'Purple Ghost' captures a landscape with its dramatic show of deep lavender and purple. This selection by our friend Talon Buchholz is a spectacular selection. This is a tree you will want in your garden.
